inputs.utterance: create a calc to group sales amount into revenue brackets: <= 10,000, 10,001–20,000, 20,001–30,000, and over 30,000.

calculatedFieldFormula.formula: IF [Sales] <= 10000 THEN '<= 10,000' ELSEIF [Sales] > 10000 AND [Sales] <= 20000 THEN '10,001–20,000' ELSEIF [Sales] > 20000 AND [Sales] <= 30000 THEN '20,001–30,000' ELSE 'Over 30,000' END
